regime_context: The detector shows a broad, non-directional rotation (9 of 16 themes eligible, 56% breadth, absorption 0.33) with no single dominant narrative. The only validated edge is the absolute-trend gate for drawdown control; momentum rank is a focus lens, not alpha. Given the track record's modest 30% directional accuracy, I default to low conviction across the board.
emerging_watch: Watching Oil & Gas Producers (XEG.TO): rank-1 but with the weakest durability_bar (0.56) and mixed hurst_tag versus the cleaner trend profiles behind it. If breadth holds below 0.50 while Consumer Staples and Big Banks maintain breadth above 0.90 for two consecutive weeks, the leadership read weakens toward consolidation rather than new highs.

theses.subject: Consumer Staples & Retail
theses.thesis: This theme scores highest on durability (0.83) and shows full breadth (1.0) with a trend tag, while remaining eligible on the absolute-trend gate. The rank-2 momentum placement is treated only as a focus signal, but the durable, broad-based trend structure is the strongest staying-power profile in the current set. Crowding (z=1.01) is a size-down caution, not a fade.
theses.dissent: Crowding z of 1.01 flags the theme as the most crowded eligible name, and crowding marks tops in attention spikes; the theme may be late-stage.

falsifier.text: XST.TO rotates below its 50-day average and stays there for five consecutive sessions before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks show a strong durability_bar of 0.82, perfect breadth (1.0), and a trend tag, and they are not crowded (z=0.77). This is a clean trend-following profile that passes the absolute-trend gate without the crowding caution attached to Consumer Staples.
theses.dissent: Financials are tightly linked to the macro narrative around inflation and policy; any surprise there hits banks first, and unscheduled news share is high (0.78).

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO underperforms XST.TO by more than 4% over any rolling 10-session window before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Utilities & Renewables show a strong durability_bar of 0.74, 75% breadth, a trend tag, and are the least crowded of the trend-tagged eligible names (z=-0.27). This offers a different risk texture within the eligible set — a trend leg without the crowding present in Consumer Staples.
theses.dissent: Score of 0.372 is significantly below the top themes, and the theme has structural rate sensitivity in a market where inflation is a macro narrative.

falsifier.text: XUT.TO fails to hold above its 200-day average for more than five consecutive sessions before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
